title: Ambitions Authority Reference
description: Machine documentation for an authority or evidence reference linked to canon requirements.

reference_id.description: Stable identifier for the referenced external artifact or evidence item.

authority_class.description: Authority or evidence role of the referenced artifact.

source.description: Repository path or stable external entity locator.

revision.description: Version, commit, frame version, or update token for staleness checks.

requirement_ids.description: Canonical requirement IDs supported or interpreted by this reference.

approved_by.description: Optional owner identity that approved this external authority.

approval_state.description: Current review state; it never upgrades implementation or release proof by itself.

implementation_status.description: Optional evidence-bounded implementation posture associated with the reference.
